content: Dawlatshāh (writing in 892/1487) names Ibn Turka and Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī as the two most prominent intellectuals of Shahrukhid Iran, with Khwāja Muḥammad Pārsā (Khwājagānī, d. 822/1419) and Ḥusayn Khwārazmī (Kubravī, d. ca. 839/1436) as the two Sufi masters of comparable status (as reported and translated by MK; MK gives Dawlatshāh's death as 900/1494 or 913/1507).
